_meta.note: Static knowledge, opening hours, prices and booking info. Hours/prices gathered 2026-11-10/11 from the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities (egymonuments.gov.eg) and travel sites; see each record's confidence field. Official pages may lag behind recent price changes.
_meta.coordinates_note: Coordinates are approximate (4 decimals); verify with a maps API before using for routing.
_meta.hours_note: 'confidence': official = read from the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities site (egymonuments.gov.eg) on 2026-11-11; secondary_sources = found on travel sites; low_conflicting_sources = sources disagree; typical_unverified = reasonable typical value NOT confirmed. hours_type: fixed, open_air, open_market, variable, trip_based, limited_hours. Official pages did not state closed days or Ramadan hours, so confirm near the visit date; ideally serve hours from an API.

single_source_of_truth.ticket_prices: places[].prices is the sole canonical source for ticket prices. Its original tickets array and ticket-level visitor price fields are retained; no duplicate normalized_tickets or visitor_prices copies are created.
single_source_of_truth.durations: places[].recommended_duration_minutes is the canonical attraction visit duration; activities[].typical_duration remains canonical for activity duration.
single_source_of_truth.coordinates: places[].coordinates and cities[].coordinates remain canonical coordinate objects; approximate accuracy is explicitly labelled.
single_source_of_truth.derived_fields: places[].rag_content and places[].search_index are generated retrieval projections only. They must be regenerated from their declared source fields and must never be independently edited.

verification_policy.verified: Use only when a supporting source has actually been checked and a verification date is recorded.
verification_policy.estimated: A value explicitly identified as an estimate; it must not be presented as exact.
verification_policy.unavailable: No value is available; null/empty values are not zero.
verification_policy.unverified: A value exists in the original dataset but has not been independently checked in this enhancement pass.
verification_policy.requires_verification: A value is conflicting, time-sensitive, or otherwise needs confirmation before operational use.
verification_policy.legacy_dates: Original last_verified and checked_on values are preserved as source data but are not treated as proof of verification by this enhancement.
verification_policy.dynamic_fields: Ticket prices and opening hours are time-sensitive. Recorded official-page labels or URLs do not constitute current verification; they remain requires_verification until checked.

agentic_readiness.evidence_policy: No external factual research was conducted for this revision. Existing source URLs are preserved as recorded provenance, not represented as newly checked evidence. All newly introduced factual fields remain unavailable or unverified.
agentic_readiness.semantic_retrieval_policy: Bilingual semantic text is separated from structured numerical and categorical fields. Search index terms are generated only from source-provided names, category, and tags.
agentic_readiness.preservation_policy: All original collections, records, fields, values, relationships, Arabic text, and English text are retained unchanged. Enhancement fields are additive.

cities.description_en: Egypt's capital, combining Pharaonic, Coptic, Islamic and modern layers of history. Main areas: Downtown, Islamic Cairo, Coptic Cairo, Citadel area, Zamalek.

cities.description_ar: طيبة القديمة، وبتتوصف كمتحف مفتوح. البر الشرقي: معبد الكرنك ومعبد الأقصر. البر الغربي: وادي الملوك ومعبد حتشبسوت وتمثالا ممنون.

cities.description_ar: مدينة ساحلية على المتوسط أسسها الإسكندر الأكبر، وبتجمع تراث يوناني روماني ومعالم إسلامية وأجواء البحر.

cities.description_ar: مدينة منتجعات على البحر الأحمر، ونقطة انطلاق للغوص والسنوركلينج ومحمية رأس محمد ورحلات سانت كاترين.

activities.description_ar: استكشاف الشعاب المرجانية في البحر الأحمر للمبتدئين والغواصين المعتمدين، عادةً مع مراكز ومراكب مرخصة.

activities.description_en: Visits to major museums such as the Grand Egyptian Museum, NMEC, Egyptian Museum, Nubian Museum and Luxor Museum.
activities.description_ar: زيارات للمتاحف الكبرى زي المتحف المصري الكبير والحضارة والمصري بالتحرير والمتحف النوبي ومتحف الأقصر.

activities.description_en: Tours led by licensed Egyptologists or tour guides covering major archaeological and Islamic sites.
activities.description_ar: جولات بمرشدين سياحيين أو علماء مصريات مرخصين بتغطي أهم المواقع الأثرية والإسلامية.

activities.description_en: Guided or self-guided walks through historic districts such as Al-Muizz Street, Downtown Cairo and Alexandria's corniche.
activities.description_ar: جولات مشي بمرشد أو بشكل ذاتي في أحياء تاريخية زي شارع المعز ووسط البلد وكورنيش الإسكندرية.

activities.description_en: Evening show with lighting and narration at monuments such as the Giza Pyramids, Karnak and Philae.
activities.description_ar: عرض مسائي بالإضاءة والسرد في آثار زي أهرامات الجيزة والكرنك وفيله.

activities.typical_duration: about 45 to 60 minutes in the air
activities.description_en: Sunrise balloon flight over the Luxor West Bank, giving aerial views of temples and farmland.
activities.description_ar: رحلة بالون وقت الشروق فوق البر الغربي بالأقصر، بتدي منظر من فوق للمعابد والأراضي الزراعية.

planning_rules_examples.text_en: Abu Simbel requires a long road trip from Aswan, so plan it as a dedicated half-day to full-day outing.
Luxor East Bank (Karnak, Luxor Temple) and West Bank (Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut, Colossi) are best planned as separate days.
Group Giza Pyramids with the Grand Egyptian Museum, and Saqqara with Dahshur, to reduce travel time.

itineraries.title_en: 3 days in Cairo for history lovers

days.title: Giza
days.tip: Pyramids first in the morning; the museum in the afternoon is quieter and cooler.

days.title: Saqqara and Dahshur
days.tip: Hire a driver for the day; both sites are far from the city center.

days.title: Islamic and Coptic Cairo
days.tip: End the evening at Khan El-Khalili.

itineraries.title_en: One day in Giza for families

days.title: Pyramids and museum
days.tip: Take breaks in the shade and bring water; the museum is air-conditioned.

days.title: East Bank
days.tip: See Luxor Temple at sunset and at night when it is lit.

days.title: West Bank
days.tip: Start early before the heat; the Colossi are a short final stop.

days.title: Free day
days.tip: Add a balloon flight at sunrise, a felucca ride, or Luxor Museum; optional.

days.title: Philae, High Dam and Nubian life
days.tip: Felucca ride around Elephantine Island at sunset.

days.title: Abu Simbel
days.tip: A full-day trip from Aswan (about 3.5–4 hours each way by road, or a short flight). Leave very early.

days.title: Roman and seaside Alexandria
days.tip: Finish with sunset at Qaitbay and a seafood dinner.

days.title: Travel to Aswan
days.tip: Travel by train, road or Nile cruise (stops at Edfu and Kom Ombo).
